_help: Optional 'support the game' payments through Stripe. OFF by default. See docs/MONETIZATION.md. Everything here is PUBLIC (it ships in the page): never put a Stripe secret key in this file.
title: Support Orbital Dominion
blurb: Orbital Dominion is free to play. If you enjoy it you can chip in, which pays for development. Payments are handled by Stripe on its own page; the game never sees your card details. Supporting unlocks cosmetic extras only: no gameplay advantage, and in-game currency is never sold.
perks: Supporter badge on the title screen
